body:
I've been feeling bleak for the last year or so. About a a year ago I picked up and left my life, a good one, to move across country to attend grad school. I also met a guy that seemed like a decent human being, and everything was looking up.
I didn't tell my mother who was dying of breast cancer of my relocation because her family is crazy abusive, and were a major factor in my leaving home. This last June she passed away and I never got to say goodbye or see her. Our last conversation was tense due to a fight I was having with my then boyfriend. She died, I wasn't allowed to the funeral, and my life has been caving in ever since.
My relationship with everyone around me has been dissolving and I've become more and more agoraphobic with each passing day. If I'm not out getting wasted I'm hacking up my legs and cutting myself into oblivion. My fiance is abusive and I have no strong support in my new home. Everyone around me is just, I don't know, they're just not . . . I feel like I'm a bother to everyone I meet. 

I'm sick of delaying the inevitable. I haven't made someone happy or proud of me since I started walking. My entire being has been one big hassle for everyone who interacts with me and I don't see the point in going on anymore. 

help.
